class.name: HSMStateSpec
class.description: Describes one state. A state with [member children] is a machine and becomes a [LimboHSM]; otherwise it becomes a [BTState] when it has a [member behavior_tree], or a [LimboState]. A [member state_script] overrides the node type with the script's base. The transitions between the children of a machine are stored in that machine's [member transitions], see [HSMTransition]. In the editor, the exported properties of [member state_script] are also shown as [code]state_props/<name>[/code]. They read the value stored in [member state_properties] (or the script default) and write back into it; setting a value equal to the script default, or reverting it, removes the key.

method.name: get_declared_initial_child
method.description: Returns [member initial_child] as written, without falling back to the first child.

method.name: is_machine
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the state has children.

method.name: resolve_base_type
method.description: Returns the class the state node is built as.

members.member: Editor only: where this machine's ANYSTATE node is drawn.
The behavior tree run by the state, which makes it a [BTState].
Child states. A state with children is a machine.
Editor only: where the state is drawn on the graph.
Editor only: the size of a machine's box when resized by hand. Zero means fit to contents.
The child the machine starts in. Defaults to the first child when not set.
The name of the state node.

Property values for the state node, keyed by property name, for example [code]{"max_suspend": 30.0, "survives": PackedStringArray(["light"])}[/code]. When [LimboHSM] builds the node, each entry is applied with [method Object.set] after [member state_script] is attached and before the machine is initialized, so [method LimboState._setup] already sees them. Values are deep-copied per node, so machines built from the same resource never share them. A key the node has no property for is ignored with a warning (once per state and property). With [member HierarchicalStateMachine.base], a child file overrides the base per key: keys it does not name keep the base's values.
The script attached to the state node.
